name: Hitori Onri
source:
The Great Onani Master, Onri Hitori.
He was bullied since childhood because of his odd name, which turned him into a social outcast.
Hitori takes pride in his unique ability of getting off to any girl.
After being assigned to a male-only department he decides to broaden his horizons.
